name: School IF
divergenceSummary: Subaru never crosses over into the fantasy world of Lugunica. Instead, he wakes up in modern Japan as a third-year student attending Lugunica Private High School alongside familiar classmates and faculty.
headline: Lugunica Academy Days
description: Subaru lives out a quirky high school romance where classmates, teachers, and club presidents mirror the heroes and villains of the four nations.

events.name: Spring Entrance & The Silver-Haired Transfer Student
events.description: Subaru arrives late with toast in hand and literally collides with Emilia, a shy half-elf exchange student who recently transferred into Class 3-A.

events.name: Rooftop Bento Standoff with Rem and Ram
events.description: Ram ruthlessly steals Subaru's potato salad while Rem secretly packs him an elaborate homemade bento, setting off a daily rooftop feud.

events.name: The Hallway Turf War with Disciplinary Head Reinhard
events.description: Subaru and Felt get caught setting up an unauthorized snack stand in the hallway. Student council president Reinhard gracefully pays for the snacks himself.

events.name: The Four Nations Cultural Festival Exhibition
events.description: Class 3-A organizes a haunted maid cafe under eccentric homeroom advisor Roswaal, where Beatrice sits in the corner library scoffing at students.

events.name: Sunset Confession Under the Blooming Cherry Blossoms
events.description: Under the sunset shadows of the academy clock tower, Subaru finally gathers his courage to deliver a direct, heartfelt confession to Emilia.
